WPMS No.99 of 2026
Bakul Khandelwal ............Petitioner
Vs.
Union of India and another ..........Respondents
Hon'ble Pankaj Purohit, J.
Mr. Nirdesh Khandelwal, learned counsel for the
petitioner, through video conferencing.
2. Mr. Saurav Adhikari, learned C.G.S.C. for the Union of
India.
3. This writ petition has been filed under Article 226 of
the Constitution of India, whereby the petitioner has sought
a direction in the nature of mandamus directing the
respondents to issue and upload the Notary Certificate of
the petitioner pursuant to Notification No.N-11013/2/2024-
NC dated 14.03.2024, which is annexed as annexure no.2 to
the writ petition.
4. On the last date, learned C.G.S.C. for the Union of
India submits that that the Government of India has issued
the Notary Certificate to the petitioner and he has shown his
willingness to hand-over the same to the learned counsel for
the petitioner if he appears before this Court today.
5. Today learned counsel for the petitioner is present
before this Court, through video conferencing, but learned
C.G.S.C. for the Union of India submits that the certificate
of practice of Notary pursuant to the Notification No.N-11013/2/2024-NC dated 14.03.2024 is uploaded on the
website of Government of India, Notary Portal.
6. The learned counsel for the petitioner did not dispute
the said submission made by learned counsel for the
respondent and further added that after uploading of the

2
said certificate of practice of Notary, the same has been
downloaded by the petitioner from the website of
Government of India, Notary Portal.
7. In such view of the matter, the writ petition has now
rendered infructuous as grievance of the petitioner has been
redressed.
8. Accordingly writ petition is dismissed as infructuous.
